name: Halo
description: A free, open-source, local screen recorder for macOS with a circular webcam bubble overlay — a free Loom alternative for Mac. Records MP4 at 1080p or 4K with hardware encoding. No cloud, no account, no AI features, no telemetry.

install_steps.step: Assemble and ad-hoc code-sign the Halo.app bundle (required for stable TCC identity)
Launch it (first launch triggers permission prompts)

verify_steps.step: Check the binary runs and reports its version (does not require any permission)
Check Halo is running (menu-bar only, no Dock icon)
Check a recording produced a real, non-zero-size file before reporting success

required_permissions.name: Screen Recording
required_permissions.system_settings_pane: Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording
required_permissions.notes: Hard blocker if missing; macOS shows the system prompt at most once per app, after which only the System Settings toggle works. Halo must be relaunched after the toggle is granted before capture works.

required_permissions.name: Camera
required_permissions.notes: Needed only for the webcam bubble. Screen recording still works without it; the bubble is simply empty.

required_permissions.name: Microphone
required_permissions.notes: Needed only for narration audio. Screen recording still works without it; the recording just has no voice track.

do: Instruct the human user to grant Screen Recording, Camera, and Microphone permissions manually in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
Instruct the user to relaunch Halo after granting Screen Recording.
Verify recording success by checking that the output .mp4 file exists and has non-zero size.
dont: Do not attempt to script, automate, or bypass TCC permission prompts — there is no supported way to grant these without the human using System Settings.
Do not claim a recording succeeded without checking the output file exists and is non-zero.
Do not re-sign or rebuild an already-authorized Halo.app in place if preserving existing permission grants matters — a changed signature can reset TCC state.
Do not describe Halo as having a cloud mode, accounts, sharing links, or AI features — none exist.
